item.title: The very stable genius
item.description: Asked about his mental fitness, the President answered with his CV, a jab at Hillary Clinton and a new job title. We asked a real president, and a few cantons, to try again.

item.title: Covfefe
item.description: Six words, one of which does not exist. The post stayed up for hours. A real president would have issued a correction; Fribourg and the Nord have other explanations.

item.title: Nobody knew health care could be so complicated
item.description: A discovery announced to the nation’s governors, many of whom had known for some time. Neuchâtel and Lyon were not surprised either.
